newsitem.title: INDONESIA: East Timorese said evicted from French embassy.
newsitem.headline: East Timorese said evicted from French embassy.

text.p: East Timorese sources said three East Timorese men who broke into the French embassy in Jakarta earlier on Wednesday in a bid for political asylum in Portugal had been evicted from the mission.
A spokesman at the embassy said: "There are no East Timorese in the French embassy." He refused to elaborate.
The spokesman repeated his statement when asked if the three men had broken into the embassy in the early hours of the day.

A Reuters reporter saw the three men in the forecourt of the embassy shortly before dawn. They identified themselves by name and said they had broken in to seek political asylum in Portugal in protest against Indonesia's 1976 annexation of East Timor, a former Portuguese colony.
Some hours later, East Timorese sources said security guards in the embassy had evicted the three men from the mission. they said two of the three were injured while being forced out.
The embassy spokesman refused to comment on the report. It was not known where the three had gone.
